states.name: after_check_1
states.description: Venice mask model is loaded and added to the scene

states.name: after_check_2
states.description: Parrot model is loaded and visible in the scene

states.name: after_check_3
states.description: Both models are positioned apart so they do not overlap, mask on the left and parrot on the right

states.name: after_check_4
states.description: Clicking on the mask model selects it and displays an info panel or highlight indicating selection

states.name: after_check_5
states.description: Clicking on the parrot model selects it and displays parrot-specific educational content

states.name: after_check_6
states.description: A quiz UI element exists in the DOM with at least one question and multiple answer choices

states.name: after_check_7
states.description: Answering a quiz question correctly updates the score or progress state and triggers an animation sequence

states.name: after_check_8
states.description: An animated sequence plays after unlocking, with at least one object having a running AnimationMixer action

states.name: after_check_9
states.description: OrbitControls or equivalent rotation controls are active allowing the user to rotate the camera around the models

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["mask","multi","asset","education"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: Venice mask model is loaded and added to the scene

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["parrot","multi","asset","education"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: Parrot model is loaded and visible in the scene

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["mask","parrot","multi","asset"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: Both models are positioned apart so they do not overlap, mask on the left and parrot on the right
Clicking on the mask model selects it and displays an info panel or highlight indicating selection
Clicking on the parrot model selects it and displays parrot-specific educational content
A quiz UI element exists in the DOM with at least one question and multiple answer choices
Answering a quiz question correctly updates the score or progress state and triggers an animation sequence
An animated sequence plays after unlocking, with at least one object having a running AnimationMixer action
OrbitControls or equivalent rotation controls are active allowing the user to rotate the camera around the models

_conversion_note: Converted from legacy checks[] format. check.script references to window.scene/window.__scene replaced with window.__3D_STATE__.__scene. Models must expose scene object via window.__3D_STATE__.__scene = scene.
